reviews.rationale: Selected GAAP rows from the Q3 exhibit show revenue and operating income both higher than the Q2 baseline, with total expenses nearly flat, so the sequential operating result improved on a GAAP basis. The tax provision also rose alongside pretax income, so the after-tax improvement is not attributable to a lighter tax burden. The thesis carries no assumptions, catalysts or invalidation conditions and no consensus, guidance or non-GAAP figures, so the selected rows cannot be tested against a stated expectation or a causal driver. Research state is therefore held for review rather than upgraded.

The higher tax provision moving in the same direction as pretax income indicates the after-tax improvement was not produced by a lighter tax burden. Read narrowly, the selected evidence supports a view that the sequential GAAP operating trajectory strengthened, but it does not by itself establish a durable trend, a beat against expectations, or a valuation conclusion.","counterevidence":"Cost of revenue rose alongside revenue, so the gross-level picture is not one of pure operating leverage, and the selected rows do not show whether the revenue increase came from volume, pricing, mix, or one-time items. The tax provision increased in the same direction as pretax income, which limits how much of the after-tax gain can be read as operating quality. Research and development spending declined sequentially, which is ambiguous: it could reflect timing or capitalization rather than efficiency, and a sustained reduction in development investment would be a negative signal for a software-and-services franchise if it persisted. Selling, general and administrative expense was essentially unchanged, so the expense side offers little independent confirmation of structural cost discipline.","uncertainty":"These are selected displayed rows from two press-release exhibits, not complete filings, and the comparison is sequential only, so no year-over-year, seasonal, or full-year inference is warranted; an item not present in this extract cannot be treated as absent from the filing. Percentage-point versus percent distinctions and any accounting-identity relationships among the rows are arithmetic, not economic explanation. Evidence that would change the view includes year-over-year comparables, company guidance and its realized outcome, non-GAAP reconciliations, segment and recurring-revenue disclosure, and management commentary identifying the drivers of the revenue and expense movements; absent those, the research state remains held for review rather than advanced."},"asserted_state":{"review_id":"tr_4a098aaf199f4727a174","evidence_ids":["RS-JKHY-Q2","RS-JKHY-Q3"],"next_review_at":null,"decision_hold":true,"actionability":"blocked","alert_status":"acknowledged"}}
